items.title: A sufficient condition for the canonical map into the candidate K-injective complex to be a quasi-isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives conditions under which the canonical map from a complex to the candidate K-injective complex of the section is a quasi-isomorphism, namely a vanishing condition on the cohomology of the cohomology sheaves over a covering family (statement lines 5585-5601, whose standing set-up and displayed equation are delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5548-5584). The proof reduces the assertion through the general K-injectivity criterion to the statement that the complex is the derived limit of its truncations (proof lines 5603-5606) and then applies the companion criterion of the same section, whose hypothesis is the one appearing in the statement (proof lines 5606-5607). The non-formal content is the reduction through the K-injectivity criterion, and the author additionally records in a footnote that the vanishing hypothesis may be weakened. The claim is H2: a two-step reduction, both steps named.
